### `class TalkingState` — `common/src/main/java/villager_voices/compat/TalkingState.java`
Per-villager talking-until-tick map (docs/spec/domains/compat.md COMPAT-REQ-002): a villager is talking for exactly the half-open interval [the tick startTalking was called, untilTick) of its currently-playing reaction line's sound, false otherwise.
- `void startTalking(UUID villagerId, long untilTick)` — Marks villagerId talking through untilTick, exclusive — replaces any still-pending mark for the same id rather than extending or stacking it.
- `boolean isTalking(UUID villagerId, long now)` — now is strictly before the untilTick its most recent #startTalking call named; an id never marked, or one whose mark has expired, is false.
